generatedFrom.policy: Classify source semantics without inferring executable behavior from ruleText.

decisionDefinitions.deterministic: The rule is executable now, or has explicit structured assertion fields that make a deterministic implementation unambiguous.
decisionDefinitions.agent-required: The source explicitly declares llm/contextual evaluation; semantic interpretation is required.
decisionDefinitions.human-review: The source explicitly declares manual evaluation.
decisionDefinitions.policy-only: The source is dictionary/classification material and does not produce a verdict.
decisionDefinitions.unresolved: The rule is prose-only or otherwise lacks enough typed evidence to choose deterministic versus agent execution safely.
